test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the option that rectifies the spelling of the incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.

Students should have a good vocabulary to write an essay efectively.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. **"Effectively"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **efectively **is an **incorrectly **spelt word.
 
• The correct spelling is **"effectively".**
 
• **Effectively **(प्रभावी ढंग से) - In an effective manner; with the desired effect.
 
 
• **Example**: She communicated her ideas effectively (प्रभावी ढंग से) during the meeting.
 
 
 
• The other words in the sentence are correctly spelt.

Therefore, the correct answer is "Effectively".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• At first, we have to find out the INCORRECT SPELLING from the given sentence.
 
• Then we have to find out the CORRECT SPELLING from the given options.
